\[
\hat{x} = U_4\big(h_0 + \textstyle\sum_{k} r_k(h)\big),\quad h_0 = c(y)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(y\): The small image
- \(r_k\): A residual block
- \(U_4\): The upsampling part

A first convolution c turns the image into features h_0. Residual blocks r_k, without batch normalization, refine them, and their sum is added to h_0. An upsampling part U with pixel shuffles enlarges the result four times. The model was trained with an L1 loss, so it aims at the true image.
